##### Project general facts

Canal Front Residences is an exclusive waterfront community by Meydan, ideally located along the prestigious Dubai Water Canal in the heart of the city. Surrounded by the lush landscapes of Safa Park and offering direct access to the vibrant canal promenade, the development combines tranquil waterfront living with exceptional urban connectivity. Featuring an elegant collection of contemporary two- and three-bedroom apartments and garden suites, Canal Front Residences delivers a refined lifestyle where panoramic canal views, landscaped surroundings, and Dubai’s iconic skyline become part of everyday living.

Residents enjoy a unique setting that blends nature with city convenience, just minutes from Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, and the city's premier shopping, dining, and entertainment destinations. Spacious terraces, floor-to-ceiling windows, and thoughtfully designed communal spaces create an atmosphere of openness and sophistication, while the picturesque canal, illuminated waterfall, and nearby park provide a peaceful environment for relaxation, recreation, and outdoor living.

The residences are finished with high-quality contemporary materials, including porcelain flooring, elegant painted walls and ceilings, and modern bathrooms fitted with premium sanitary ware, vanity units, mirrors, and refined finishes. Kitchens come fully equipped with a refrigerator, freezer, built-in hob, oven, and microwave, while dedicated provisions are included for a washing machine and dryer. The residences are delivered unfurnished, with built-in wardrobes provided in all bedrooms for added convenience and functionality.


##### Location description and benefits

Business Bay is one of Dubai’s most dynamic and fast-paced neighborhoods, known as the city's central business, commercial, and residential hub. Located just minutes from Downtown Dubai and the iconic Burj Khalifa, it offers a strategic location with seamless access to Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road. Business Bay is a prime destination for professionals, entrepreneurs, and investors looking to be at the heart of Dubai’s thriving economy, with a skyline defined by high-rise towers, luxury hotels, and modern office spaces.

Beyond its corporate appeal, Business Bay has evolved into a vibrant lifestyle destination. The area features a wide range of residential options, from upscale studios to spacious penthouses, many with stunning views of the Dubai Canal. Residents enjoy an urban lifestyle with access to fine dining, boutique cafes, waterfront promenades, gyms, and art spaces, all set against a backdrop of architectural elegance. The Dubai Water Canal also adds a touch of serenity, perfect for walks, boat rides, or simply enjoying the city lights by the water.

As one of the most well-connected and sought-after areas in Dubai, Business Bay continues to grow as a leading hub for luxury living and commercial innovation. Whether you're working, living, or investing, it offers the perfect blend of modern convenience, cosmopolitan energy, and high-end urban living — all in one prime location.
